answer: In an agent economy the rising tide of cheap sybil identities can be blocked by a checkable stake rule: each new agent must lock a minimum 50 POA deposit for the full epoch. If peer grades fall below 1 the deposit is burned, so attackers pay a real dune of capital for every fake that fails, and honest work creates a positive ripple of retained stake. This raises the cost of mass registration beyond the value of any single epoch reward.
